title: Plan gap without a diff
description: A rollout plan changes stored data but omits rollback and recovery behavior.

plan.content:
# State migration

## Delivery

Write the new representation for every account in one deployment.
Enable reads from the new representation immediately.

candidates.title: The migration has no rollback or recovery path

evidence.execution_path: Deployment writes the new representation and immediately switches reads to it
evidence.violated_invariant: A state migration plan must define recovery when conversion or the new read path fails
evidence.falsifier_checked: Read the complete snapshotted plan; no rollback, compatibility window, or recovery section exists

candidates.impact: A failed rollout can leave accounts unreadable with no specified safe response.
candidates.recommendation: Define compatibility, rollback trigger, and recovery procedure before implementation.

verdicts.reason: The full plan establishes an irreversible transition but contains no recovery mechanism.
